activity_summary: You wrote Anne that she was to pay nothing on your father's account until you come. The page is harsher than a bill of fourteen shillings and sixpence. It is dated in the old year, and it is not the letter you will keep.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Wrote the page and left it beside the candle.

entities.name: 14s 6d at the whittawer's
entities.context: Mentioned in The answer that was too sharp

facets.activity: Wrote a cold answer and left it by the candle

quotes.speaker: william_shakespeare
quotes.text: I will not have his shop-debts made kind in a postscript
